As seen in Fig.2, there were many dimples and cleavage fracture on the tensile crack. Its fracture mechanism was the mixture of ductile and cleavage mode.

Firstly the yield strength, working-hardening of the particles of iron powders decreased under the temperature of warm compaction. The plastic deformation of powders increased and the pores decreased.
Secondly polymer lubricants were in the vitrification state and changed the surface properties under press temperature. They improved the lubrication effect and decreased the friction resistance.
